bio: Patricia Ann Thomas "Pat" Moore (born 1958) is an American politician who has represented the 17th district in the Louisiana House of Representatives since 2019. A member of the Democratic Party, she represents parts of Ouachita Parish. She previously served on the Ouachita Parish Police Jury from 2007 to 2019.
